name: typescript-guard-runtime
cmd: set -eu; case "${GDP_WRAPPER_RUN:-typescript-owned}" in *[!A-Za-z0-9_-]*) exit 2;; esac; prefix=runs/typescript-resolution/${GDP_WRAPPER_RUN:-typescript-owned}; test ! -e "$prefix"; timeout 90s bun install --frozen-lockfile; NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 bun run build; mkdir -p "$prefix/core" "$prefix/wrapper"; npm pack --json --pack-destination "$prefix/core" > "$prefix/core/core-pack.json"; (cd packages/cli && npm pack --json --pack-destination "../../$prefix/wrapper") > "$prefix/wrapper/wrapper-pack.json"; NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 bun research/security/wrapper-execution.ts --typescript-guard-only --core-pack "$prefix/core/core-pack.json" --wrapper-pack "$prefix/wrapper/wrapper-pack.json" --out "$prefix/evidence" --emit-packet

name: typescript-guard-checks
cmd: timeout 90s bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun test ./research/security/wrapper-typescript-guard.test.ts && NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 bunx tsc --noEmit --allowImportingTsExtensions --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution bundler --types bun --strict --skipLibCheck --noImplicitReturns --noFallthroughCasesInSwitch --noUncheckedIndexedAccess research/security/wrapper-execution.ts research/security/wrapper-typescript-guard.ts research/security/wrapper-typescript-guard.test.ts && bunx oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings --disable-nested-config research/security/wrapper-execution.ts research/security/wrapper-typescript-guard.ts research/security/wrapper-typescript-guard.test.ts
